targets.what: The read API itself: the library and the `onepipeline-api` binary, on crates.io.
targets.published_by: .github/workflows/release.yml — the publish-crate job's `cargo publish`, under Cargo.toml's [package] name.

targets.what: The same binary, as per-platform wheels maturin wraps it in.
targets.published_by: .github/workflows/release.yml — the publish-pypi job, under pyproject.toml's [project] name.

targets.what: The same binary again, as the launcher a consumer installs. The per-platform packages under `covers` exist only for this launcher to resolve at its own exact version, so nothing depends on one by name and they are not targets of their own.
targets.published_by: .github/workflows/release.yml — the publish-npm job, from `npm-build.mjs launcher` and, for the covered names, `npm-build.mjs platform` over the build-npm target matrix.

targets.what: The browser view: the built frontend bundle, carrying no binary. A consumer serves this against the read API above, and one release stamps both — serving one release's view against another release's data is what pairing them prevents.
targets.published_by: .github/workflows/release.yml — the publish-npm job's `npm-build.mjs ui`, under npm/onepipeline-ui/package.json's name.

retired.why: What the wrappers published as up to v0.1.0. Nothing here publishes it again; a consumer pinning it is pinned to 0.1.0. See AGENTS.md.
The npm half of the same retirement, also frozen at 0.1.0.
